messages:
maya: Quick sync — we need to schedule a ~90m Threat Modeling + Access Review for the Private deployment flow. Goal: finalize threat model, review IAM access matrix, and assign SOC2 evidence owners. Who's available next week? Need infra, sec, product + compliance.
ajay: I can do Tue or Wed. Options: Mon 10:00-11:30, Tue 15:00-16:30, Wed 09:00-10:30. Prefer Tue.
rachel: Tue works better for me. Can we try to keep it to 60m and schedule a 30m follow-up if needed? Happy to go longer if we need hands-on triage.
sophie: Tue 15:00-16:30 is fine. I'll drop pre-reads in the thread: threat model draft and access matrix. Please read before the meeting.
maya: Thanks — Sophie, can you paste links here? Also propose an agenda so folks can prep.
sophie: Links:
• https://internal.docs/redwood/threat-models/private-deploy-draft
• https://sheets.internal/redwood/access-matrix/private-deploy

Agenda suggestion (60–90m):
```
1) 10m — Context & high-level goals (maya)
2) 25m — Threat model walkthrough + open risks (sophie)
3) 20m — IAM access matrix & required mitigations (ajay / infra-eng)
4) 15m — SOC2 evidence owners / timelines (luis)
5) 10m — Action items + follow-ups
```
If we cap at 60m, drop item 2 deep-dive and schedule follow-up triage.
luis: I can own SOC2 evidence collection for Private. I'll need a short list of artifact types we expect (access logs, deployment configs, key rotation docs). Can infra-eng note owners for each role?
infra-eng: I'll map owners for infra bits. For app-level access I need product to confirm role names. Can we have product reps on the call? @rachel — can you invite someone from product if you think it's needed?
rachel: Yep, I'll invite priya from product. Also, Ajay — can you bring the current RBAC templates?
ajay: Will attach RBAC template to the invite.
security-bot: Reminder: attach compliance checklist to the calendar invite and set meeting visibility to private when sensitive links are included.
maya: Okay consensus = Tue 15:00–16:30. I'll create the invite for that slot, set it to 90m but note we aim for 60. Invitees: eng leads, infra-eng, product (Priya), compliance, Sophie, Luis. Please accept or propose alternates by EOD tomorrow.
sophie: Pre-read uploaded and request for reviewers added to doc (commented). Please add inline comments by EOD Monday if you want them covered in the walk-through.
luis: I'll prepare a draft owner list and initial artifact checklist; will post in thread by Monday noon.
ajay: I'll attach RBAC templates and a short runbook for emergency access processes.
rachel: +1 on Tue. Also, can we add a quick slot for a short canary deployment permissions check? 10 min at the end.
maya: Good call — adding 10m canary permission check to the end of agenda.
infra-eng: Quick note: we may need 1-2 devs on call if we hit a code/config question. I'll ping the oncall if needed.
maya: Cool. I'll send the invite and link the doc + sheets. If anyone has blocking conflicts, DM me.
ajay: :thumbsup:
rachel: 👍
sophie: thanks!
security-bot: Meeting created: https://calendar.internal.redwood/event/1763204500-security-review (auto)
maya: Closing loop — invite sent, docs attached. See you Tue 15:00.
